claim: More informed discussions between physicians and older adults about the consequences of an initial osteoporotic fracture could encourage more patients to consider treatments that protect against future fracture.
source: More informed discussions between physicians and older adults about the consequences of an initial osteoporotic fracture could encourage more patients to consider treatments that protect against future fracture.
evidence: This claim is speculative in nature, proposing a potential outcome (encouraging treatment consideration) based on hypothetical improved physician-patient communication about fracture consequences.
